name: v1.262.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix an overflow during fuzzing by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2749
* Add a FIXME for #2731 by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2732
* Remove component names subsumed by external-id by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2735
* Implement cm64 handling for `thread.new-indirect` by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2733
* Limit types in `rec` groups in components by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2726
* Improve handling of `exact` functions in components by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2729
* Fix some edge case behavior of btree collections by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2751
* Fix subtyping of globals in components by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2750
* Fix type checks in components w.r.t. kebab-names by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2752
* Increase the maximum number of tables by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2756
* Fix some minor issues with components and named imports by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2753
* Fix a panic validating components & resources by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2754
* Fix a panic when processing an invalid component by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2757
* Fix an exponential algorithm validating components by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2755
* Fix some minor issues with incremental-parse fuzzer by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2759
* Disallow `borrow` types in `task.return` immediates by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2761
* Scope the debug-only arity-tracking a bit more by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2758
* OperatorValidator: reduce debug state used to check arity by @keithw in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2762
* Revert "feat(wit-parser): Add support for a custom WIT package `deps` path (#2677)" by @celarye in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2764
* wasmparser: share the function subtyping check by @Lstarsky0 in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2765
* Make `component target` semver compatible by @chenyan2002 in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2763
* Keep track of more type depth in wit-smith by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2769
* Remove `explicit_resources` maps by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2760
* Rename `versionsuffix` to `version-suffix` in the text format by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2770
* Release wasm-tools 1.262.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2771


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/compare/v1.261.0...v1.262.0
